title.narrative: Value-driven dialogue for value-driven policy making

description.narrative: The project is implemented in Serbia. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights. The main right holders are active citizens and members of social democratic parties. Through townhall meetings, position papers and wide dissemination of outputs, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Democratic Dialogue Network, Social Democratic Women Srmland, Social Democratic Women Norrbotten, Sunderby Folkhgskola, and The Palme Center.Other Donors to the OrganisationFredrich Ebert Foundation willing to co-finance translation of events. Follow up.Project ObjectiveThe project objective is to mobilise active citizens in Serbia around social democratic and liberal values and reach decision-makers with demands on such policies.Actor groups--Decision-makers-- Members of local community/municipal assemblies --Actors in Cooperation-- Progressive and social-democratic oriented political parties Recognized and currently active progressive personalities and activists Youth and women organisations connected to social democratic parties Civil society organizations Media, academia and the arts recognised as opinion makers in Serbian society --Rights-holders-- Active citizens Members of social democratic parties Women
